objective: Matched F2 research ablation for the already-defined WP804 ambiguity adapter: hold the initial public observation, WP804 ABSTAIN result, action budget, and candidate count constant; vary only the exact public-compatible goal alternative set; require the thin Hyperposition plus Epistemic Action Selection path to produce different uniquely optimal bounded probe proposals where the binary-ABSTAIN baseline has no state sufficient to distinguish the cases.
hypothesis: Preserving the exact compatible goal set as non-authoritative Hyperposition alternatives is sufficient for existing deterministic epistemic selection to choose the uniquely higher-information legal probe in each matched case without creating a new ambiguity subsystem.
counterhypothesis: The existing Hyperposition and epistemic-selection primitives do not gain useful discriminatory power from compatible goal-set structure alone; any observed different probe requires ad-hoc externally supplied scores and therefore the proposed thin adapter is not yet causally demonstrated.
falsifier: If two matched cases with identical ABSTAIN/public-observation/budget require different probes but the adapter cannot derive different discriminator information-gain ordering from goal-set-to-probe outcome partitions without hand-assigned case-specific ranking scores, classify E4 as NOT_YET_CAUSALLY_DEMONSTRATED rather than PASS.
